title: Unique bounded intrinsic standard t-structures
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne D.p$, and a scheme $Y$ of finite type over $D.k$. For every finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, there is a unique t-structure $t_E$ [def-weil-t-structure] on the intrinsic raw rational category [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] whose degree-$n$ halves are exactly sfRationalStandardClass true/false $n$ [def-weil-constructible-standard-tstructure], and every object is bounded for $t_E$. For an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, the actual common-stage category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] likewise has a unique t-structure with halves sfCommonStageStandardClass true/false $n$, bounded on every object. These assertions do not include any scalar-extension or pullback truncation comparisons.

proof.text: By lem-sf-intrinsic-integral-standard-truncations the intrinsic integral full subcategory is bounded and stable under both ambient truncations. Induce the ambient t-structure on this subcategory. Its halves are precisely the vanishing conditions defining the integral standard classes. Form the isomorphism-closed images under raw rationalization. Shift compatibility propagates the bounds. Tensor induction on localized morphisms reduces orthogonality to integral orthogonality. Localize the integral truncation triangle for triangle existence. Integral bounds give rational boundedness, and equality of both class functions determines the t-structure uniquely. This is the existing proved sfRationalStandardTStructure_existsUnique, not a use of constructibleTruncations_exists.

Finite scalar extension preserves all homology vanishing conditions: exact ordinary extension preserves zero homology, and sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison identifies its derived functor with completed extension. Rational scalar extension has the same integral object action. For the common-stage halves use their prescribed existential class functions. Inclusions and their shift comparisons prove shift closure; move any morphism between opposite halves to one common coefficient field, where rational orthogonality kills it. Map the finite-stage truncation triangle through the exact inclusion. Each literal pair inherits its finite-stage bounds. Equality of both class functions again gives uniqueness. These are the steps of the existing proved sfCommonStageStandardTStructure_existsUnique.

lean.statement:
theorem sfRationalStandardTStructure_existsUnique :
    ∃! t : CategoryTheory.Triangulated.TStructure (sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E Y),
      (∀ n : ℤ, t.le n = sfRationalStandardClass l E Y true n ∧
        t.ge n = sfRationalStandardClass l E Y false n) ∧ ∀ K, t.bounded K
